snippet.title: Mining and Dwarves - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987230/Mining_and_Dwarves/

Mining and Dwarves is an incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Use powerful abilities for maximum gains, or relax and let your dwarves do the work.
